paragraphs: The Plant Watering Reminder Using STM32 And Soil Moisture Sensor project is a hardware-based system designed to alert users when their plants need water, using an STM32 Blue Pill microcontroller and a soil moisture sensor module. The project utilizes the arduino_stm32core framework for development, focusing on GPIO, ADC, Timers, and UART interfaces. The system is self-contained with deterministic onboard control and telemetry, ensuring reliable plant watering reminders.

The STM32 Blue Pill is a popular microcontroller board from STMicroelectronics, featuring an ARM Cortex-M3 processor running at 72 MHz. It has 64 KB of Flash memory and 20 KB of SRAM, making it suitable for low-power applications like this project. The Blue Pill also includes on-board indicators such as an LED and a buzzer alert module.

The soil moisture sensor module is designed to measure the moisture content in the soil using analog voltage output from the PA0 pin. This data is then processed by the STM32 microcontroller to determine if the plant needs water. The system uses a timer to periodically sample the soil moisture level and compare it to predefined thresholds.

The active buzzer alert module is connected to the PA1 pin of the STM32 Blue Pill, which generates an audible notification when the plant needs water. This alert helps users quickly identify when their plants require watering.
